description: This file defines a class named HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector. The class's purpose is to identify URLs within text tokens and convert them into clickable links by inserting HTML anchor tags. The handleText method processes tokens, detects URLs using a regex, and wraps recognized URLs in anchor tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify
classes.description: A class for converting URLs within text into HTML links by injecting <a> tags.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes a text token to find URLs using a regex and converts detected URLs into clickable links by wrapping them with <a> tags.
